messages:
maya: Heads up — starting a 2% canary run for model v3.2-quant4. Quick smoke shows chat-quality drift on long-context prompts (>= 2048 tokens). P95 latency is fine but p99 tail is higher. Posting quick numbers.

liam: can you paste the smoke numbers and the slices?

maya: ```
model: v3.2-quant4
slice: long-context (>=2048 tokens)
samples: 1,200
quality.delta: -3.6% (human rubric mean)
auto-evals.bleu.delta: -1.2%
latency.p95: 320ms (baseline 300ms)
latency.p99: 1.4s (baseline 0.9s)
hallucination.rate: +0.4%
```

sophia: that's borderline. our current canary rollback rule is: quality.delta <= -2% OR p99 increase > +50%.

arjun: p99 increased ~55% vs baseline, so that meets the latency rollback condition. Is the regression concentrated on certain prompt types?

maya: yes — concentrated on >2k token contexts and codegen style prompts. shadow compare between int4 quantized weights and fp16 shows the diffs line up with those slices.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: canary v3.2-quant4 started at 2% (deploy-id: d-1743200000).

liam: propose we: 1) reduce initial canary to 0.5%, 2) enable KV prefix caching for canary traffic, 3) add soft-route fallback that sends >2k token requests to v3.2-fp16.

maya: config snippet I'm about to push: ```
rollout:
  initial: 0.5%
  step: 0.5%
  max: 10%
  gating:
    quality_delta_threshold: -2.0
    latency_p99_mul: 1.5
    sample_slice: ["long-context", "codegen"]
  fallback:
    type: route
    condition: token_length >= 2048
    target: v3.2-fp16
```

sophia: agree. also add an automated alert when drift > 2% over a 1h window and an auto-rollback after 30m if no improvement.

arjun: SGTM. also capture exemplar prompts where hallucination rate spiked and attach them to the ticket.

maya: I'll patch the rollout config, rerun smoke with 5k focused shadow samples on long-context + codegen, and hold the active canary until we validate. Opening ticket.

liam: if the shadow run looks clean, we can attempt a staged increase with the route-fallback in place. otherwise rollback.

maya: ticket INF-4521 created — attaching smoke logs, shaded diffs, and eval harness job id. cc @liam @sophia @arjun :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary paused (d-1743200000) due to manual hold.
